name: cnsplots
summary: Publication-quality scientific figures in Python via the cnsplots package, including the rcParams style contract and grid/multi-panel composition patterns.

verification.method: mamba env with cnsplots 0.7.0; ran all four bundled scripts; ran all three templates and rendered each to PNG for visual inspection; measured the rcParams before/after diff and every settings value rather than transcribing them; empirically tested multipanel panel alignment, below= stacking, GridSpec-in-panel durability across savefig, and the inset_axes alternative.
verification.notes: mutool absent in this environment, so SVG export falls back to plain matplotlib SVG with a RuntimeWarning; unrelated to skill correctness.
